title: How is Queen Victoria connected to Big Bird?
description:
Four real photos connect Queen Victoria to Big Bird from Sesame Street, through a king who gave up his throne, a president and a first lady.

Queen Victoria → Edward VIII → Richard Nixon → Pat Nixon → Big Bird

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Queen Victoria → Edward VIII: In 1895 at Balmoral, Queen Victoria posed with her baby great-grandson, the future King Edward the Eighth.
   Photo by Robert Milne, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Queen_Victoria_with_family_members.jpg
2. Edward VIII → Richard Nixon: In 1970, Edward, who gave up the throne to become Duke of Windsor, dined at Richard Nixon's White House.
   Photo by Jack Kightlinger, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Nixon_greets_the_Duke_and_Duchess_of_Windsor_-_NARA_-_194310.tif
3. Richard Nixon → Pat Nixon: From 1969 to 1974, Pat Nixon served beside him as first lady.
   Photo by White House photo by Ollie Atkins, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Richard_Nixon_and_First_Lady_Pat_Nixon.jpg
4. Pat Nixon → Big Bird: And in December 1970, Big Bird visited Pat Nixon at the White House with a Christmas gift feather.
   Photo by The Nixon library, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pat_Nixon_and_Big_Bird.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#queenvictoria #bigbird #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
